verdict.rationale: Snyk has some automation of its own. Snyk Studio's default hooks-based approach automatically checks code written by AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Snyk also supports PR-based fix workflows, which community users describe as automated PRs. However, the LLM Remediation Agent is triggered on demand (`snyk fix --agentic` is explicitly human-in-the-loop, `/snyk-fix` is invoked manually), and running in CI/CD is a host-platform capability rather than Snyk's own background automation. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable background automations, recurring schedules or triggers for autonomous agent runs, autonomous (non-interactive) remediation-agent operation, independent corroboration of the hooks behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Snyk Studio supports a default hooks-based approach for some agentic development environments (ADEs) to ensure code written by AI coding assistants is secure at inception (SAI)
supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests
